summary: New box Preterit: example for sense 1 in Preterit (PrS 50/100)

data.turoyo: Ummo: "Qumle, huwe gawro w hat gawro, ayna d qṭile u ḥreno." Mṭaʕən, qayəm, mədle luwe w l Kandar l ḥḏoḏe.
data.translation: Da sagte sie: "Stell auf vor ihm, er ist ein Held und du bist ein Held; wer den andern tötet, dem will ich gehören." Das erregte Qarataschdin's Zorn. Er stand nun auf, und er und Kandar packten einander.

rationale: New II Detransitive Preterit box; challenge to the man's status triggers an unagented emotional reaction and immediate fight, directly supporting existing Detransitive sense 1.

summary: Mṭaʕən has no l-series agent and narrates the man's reaction to a challenge before he rises to fight. Keep the inherited II Detransitive category and emotional sense, not the physical loading root.

The experiencer is the narrative subject; the stimulus is the preceding quoted challenge, without a coded complement. German anger is the contextual effect; no additional general anger sense is established.
Lookup ṭʕn 1 shows physical carrying/loading and related endurance uses, but the exact emotional Detransitive paradigm is under ṭʕn 2 and non-emphatic tʕn.
The Preterit base shape occurs in the headword, but the supplied entry previously had only a Detransitive Infectum example. A headword form is not an existing textual box.
The matching tʕn entry warrants cross-reference and phonological/editorial review, not silent consonant normalisation.
Are tʕn and ṭʕn 2 dialectal variants of one emotional-reaction verb, or distinct editorial root allocations? Confirm the t/ṭ contrast before consolidation.
